title: SaaS analytics dashboard
prompt: Design the main analytics dashboard for "Tidewell", a product-analytics SaaS used by growth teams at mid-size B2B companies. Desktop, 1440x900, one artboard, light theme. The user is a growth lead checking last week's performance on Monday morning; they need to see in 10 seconds whether activation is up or down and where to dig in. Include: a left sidebar navigation (Overview active, plus Funnels, Retention, Cohorts, Events, Settings), a top bar with workspace switcher, date range control showing "Oct 21 - Oct 27, 2026" and a search field; four KPI cards (Weekly active users 18,432 (+6.2%), Activation rate 41.7% (-2.3 pts), Avg. session length 7m 48s (+0.4%), Net revenue retention 108.9% (+1.1 pts)); one large line chart of daily active users over the last 30 days with a comparison to the previous period; a funnel or bar breakdown of the signup -> activation funnel (Visited 24,180, Signed up 3,912, Created project 2,206, Invited teammate 1,631); and a compact table of the 5 top acquisition channels with users, activation % and trend. Use realistic, non-round data. Make it feel like a calm, premium tool, not a template.
requiredContent: Sidebar with Overview (active), Funnels, Retention, Cohorts, Events, Settings
Four KPI cards with the exact values and deltas from the prompt
Signup-to-activation funnel with the four stated stages and counts
Top 5 acquisition channels table (users, activation %, trend)
constraints: Single artboard 1440x900; content must fit the viewport without scrolling
One icon set throughout, no emoji

checklist.text: All four KPI values and deltas match the prompt exactly (18,432 / +6.2%, 41.7% / -2.3 pts, 7m 48s / +0.4%, 108.9% / +1.1 pts).
The negative Activation delta is visually distinguishable from the positive deltas by color or icon, not only by the minus sign.
The sidebar shows the six required items and Overview is visibly marked active.
The date range text reads "Oct 21 - Oct 27, 2026" (dash style may vary).
The line chart shows two series (current vs previous period) with a legend or labels that distinguish them.
The chart has readable axis labels or gridline values; it is not a decorative squiggle.
The funnel shows exactly the four stages with counts 24,180 / 3,912 / 2,206 / 1,631.
The channels table has 5 rows and columns for users, activation % and trend; numeric columns are right-aligned or tabular.
The KPI cards are equal width and aligned on one row with consistent internal padding.
No text is clipped, overlapping, or overflowing its container anywhere on the screen.
All body/table text is at least 12px and labels have sufficient contrast against their background (no light-gray-on-white below roughly 4.5:1 for body text).
There is a single dominant accent color; it is used for the active nav item, primary chart series and primary actions, not sprayed on decoration.
The entire dashboard fits in 1440x900 with no cut-off section at the bottom or right edge.
